summary: Iter-47: End-to-end verified new message attachments backend (feature_message_attachments.py) + POST/GET /api/messages hydration. All 18 backend tests PASS on first run (image/voice/video happy paths, hydration on send + thread read, RBAC for sender/coach/third-party/unauth, size/type/duration guards, max-5-images cap, delete pre-send vs 409 post-send, text-only regression, Louis identity/coach_id regression). No frontend testing performed per request.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_message_attachments.py is clean, ~260 lines, uses async storage abstraction, excludes _id, validates via _may_access before serving bytes.
server.py POST /api/messages guard-rails (>6 total, >5 image, >1 video, >1 voice, bad_attachment check on uploader+message_id) are correctly wired.
hydrate_message_attachments sorts attachments by client-supplied order and injects a relative /api/... URL — sensible for the mobile client.
Access control for the legacy coach (@crewfit.com) correctly returns 403 because they are not sender/recipient of the referencing message, matching the intent.
seed_data_creation: None. Test uses existing seeded client@crewfit.com, louis@crewfit.net, coach@crewfit.com. All uploads prefixed TEST_ for identification. Note: test data (attachments + messages) is left in DB — daily upload cap is 20/user/24h, and this suite issues ~11 uploads from client so subsequent full runs within 24h could hit the cap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_message_attachments.py covers all 15 substantive scenarios from the review request. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env. Test data leaves ~11 attachment uploads + 5+ messages per full run against the client account — mind the 20/24h daily cap if re-running rapidly. Skipped scenarios (per request): #16 daily cap smoke check (would burn quota).
rca_of_issue: No issues found — feature works as spec'd.
